resources.string: Watches only the YouTube app. When the Shorts player or the Shorts tab appears, it presses Back for you. It reads nothing from other apps and has no internet access.

How to turn it on:
1. Tap “Open Accessibility Settings”.
2. Find “Shorts Blocker” (often under “Downloaded apps” or “Installed apps”) and switch it on.
3. If the switch is greyed out (Android 13+), tap “Open App Info”, then ⋮ (top right) → “Allow restricted settings”, and try step 2 again.
✅ The service is turned on in Accessibility settings.
⚠️ The service is OFF. Turn it on in Accessibility settings (steps below).
No internet permission, no analytics, no data collection. Debug logs stay on your phone.
